## What's Changed

### Versioning Note
- `v0.3.0` supersedes `v0.2.0` as the latest recommended release. This is a minor release because it hardens the built-in editable Draw.io export contract with broader semantic coverage, higher-fidelity edge/card/style export, and a release-oriented visual regression gate.

### Added
- Added a Draw.io Export Fidelity contract for generated HTML diagrams, covering visible labels, semantic annotations, sheet-owned content, edge geometry, style mapping, and exporter versioning. PR #27.
- Added Draw.io annotation roles and explicit ignore semantics so meaningful SVG primitives are either exported or intentionally excluded with a documented reason. PR #28.
- Added Draw.io coverage auditing to catch visible SVG elements that would otherwise be missing from editable Draw.io output. PR #29.
- Added SVG-owned sheet content export so diagram headers, metadata, and report sections can remain editable after export. PR #31, PR #44.
- Added editable semantic card export, sampled SVG path export for edges, stable edge terminal metadata, calibrated style mappings, and exporter version metadata. PR #32, PR #33, PR #34, PR #35, PR #36.
- Added a Draw.io fidelity torture sample and a visual regression release gate for pinned-renderer release validation. PR #37, PR #38.

### Fixed
- Fixed Draw.io legend and standalone semantic export handling so annotated diagram elements retain their intended structure. PR #14.
- Fixed Draw.io export labels to use visible SVG labels instead of hidden or duplicated sources. PR #30.
- Removed default SVG header duplication from generated diagrams. PR #39.
- Tightened SVG sheet spacing and scoped callouts so exported report-like diagrams stay visually aligned. PR #40.
- Exported Draw.io edge labels as editable text cells instead of losing label fidelity during edge conversion. PR #43.

### Documentation and Tests
- Documented the Draw.io export fidelity contract and stable release validation expectations in the skill instructions. PR #27, PR #38.
- Added regression coverage for annotation roles, ignored elements, coverage audits, visible-label sources, sheet content, semantic cards, sampled edges, edge terminals, style mappings, exporter version locking, report export, and the visual regression gate configuration. PR #28, PR #29, PR #30, PR #31, PR #32, PR #33, PR #34, PR #35, PR #36, PR #37, PR #38, PR #44.
- Kept local-only test folders out of the published repository. PR #45.
